∀ {U : Type*} [Group U], ∀ boundary : List Bool × List Bool,
  (∀ s t : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := U) Complex boundary,
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces s t ↔
      ∀ (A B : Subgroup U) (p q : MackeyDiagrams.Boundary A B),
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.attainable
          (fun v (label : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p q v) => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary.interpret label) (Subtype.val s) ⊆
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.attainable
          (fun v (label : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p q v) => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary.interpret label) (Subtype.val t)) ∧
  (∀ s : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := U) Complex boundary,
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces s s) ∧
  (∀ s t z : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := U) Complex boundary,
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces s t →
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces t z →
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces s z)
sourceReason: The unnumbered statement in Ian Xiao's Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, §3.3, p. 10, gives inclusion of attainable maps at each fixed boundary, reflexivity, and transitivity for shapes with the same boundary shape. The published PDF matches the project copy. Shapes share ordered bottom and top orientations. The full typed labelling fiber fixes the boundary groups and strand cosets, permits internal labels to vary, and evaluates the stored drawing. The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 in input.request applies the same finite complex linear label convention to every dot. Each term is an eligible group element, and a group-element dot is the coefficient-one singleton. The mark remains part of the shape.
